name: duckie-pomdp-f10-l2-transfer-v1
purpose: F10-L2 experiment_loop mixed-turn lane-state SAC transfer training with online W&B telemetry

install_phases.reason: Warm-reuse the validated F10-L1 CUDA environment; F10-L2 adds no dependency
install_phases.command: python -c "import gym, numpy, torch, ultralytics, wandb; print(numpy.__version__, torch.__version__, ultralytics.__version__, wandb.__version__)"

validation.import_smoke: python -c "import gym, numpy, torch, ultralytics, wandb; print(numpy.__version__, torch.__version__, ultralytics.__version__, wandb.__version__)"
validation.cuda_witness: python -c "import torch; torch.manual_seed(16000); x=torch.randn(8,8,device='cuda'); print('F10_L2_WITNESS', tuple((x@x).shape), float((x@x).sum()), torch.cuda.get_device_name())"
